For example, 'charity guide' on page 2 and 'training bulletin' on page 3 were clickable hyperlinks in the PDF, but are rendered as unlinked plain text in their respective paragraphs (the link objects are instead extracted separately at the end of the pages, breaking the inline visual connection).
